reviews.text: I was in line to pay for my vet visit and another person was in line ahead of me asking about neutering their cat.  Bickford was quoting them 1000 dollars.  They seemed dejected by the high cost.  I told them about Alberta Veterinary Clinic and that if your pet is healthy they don't demand blood work for simple procedures like neutering and they won't pressure to micro chip your pet.  The other pet owner was really thankful for the information that there was another option that was more affordable.  When I got home I had an email from Bickford Park Animal Hospital saying that they were terminating their care for my pets.

I called to find out about the cost of neutering a cat and they want $1000 . These people are  out of there ever loving minds. This is the most overpriced insane number. I’ve gotten thus far. We really need to do more to regulate the cost of veterinarian care because people are gouging the life out of patients.
We took our puppy Trixie today and had a great experience from the whole team, thanks again

When your dog pulls you to the vet on their walks, you know they are treated with love. I took my dog Ghost here for years and the only reason I stopped was moving out of the province. Everyone from the vets, techs, and reception have always been so welcoming and comforting. Even when they are so busy, they always treated my dog with patience and love.

They also never over charged me personally, always gave me options based on what care was best for my dog while also taking into account what was accessible to me financially at the time.

They also recommended a dog food that solved all of his digestive issues he’d been dealing with for years.

Thank you always!

I sent this veterinary clinic feedback about a vet telling me that my cat does not have an eye infection, and it turned out he did, in fact, need antibiotics after getting a 2nd opinion at another vet. They responded telling me it was in everyone's best interest if I went to another vet in the future, without acknowledging the mistake in care, or any kind of reflection or peer review process.

Their response is why people are cowards hiding behind Google reviews - I reached out to them directly and they were defensive and dismissive.
Best vets and care received here

Person, very nice and who loves animals
I recommend

The Bickford park animal hospital is the safest and most heard I have ever felt at a veterinary practice. I feel equipped with knowledge to better care for my cats and was outlined all possible options of treatment. It goes without saying that all team members had exemplary bedside manner. Even my most anxious most indoor cats of indoor cats had minimal stress through the entire experience.

Their doctors are considerate of budget which is so refreshing knowing how much cost of living can be in this fine city of Toronto.

I can’t put into words how wonderful this place is. I have brought my two kitty boys in since I adopted them and the service really reflects the integrity of all the people who work here. Booking is easy and accommodating, contact and communication is very streamlined and quick, and they really give you their attention and time, even if you’re a ball of anxiety like myself and have a million questions. This is reflected in their vets, vet techs, and admin team. I had a bit of a pain in the butt payment situation and they accommodated and were great conversation while we went through the process. These professionals in animal care do not get the credit they deserve for the hard work, long hours and demanding jobs they have. Again, not just the vets themselves but their administrative support team, who while I was waiting for my cats treatment, were taking calls left and right, shooting off emails, doing client outreach and much more with a near perfect consistency in how they spoke to and approached each interaction with their clients. This is the most deserving Google review I’ve typed out and I’m so greatful to have this caring team in our community keeping our pets safe and taken care of. Thank you all again so much, and if you’re reading this wondering if you should seek service here, you absolutely should.

Bickford has been our vet for 5 years. From our first day in the city to our dogs last day, the staff was always kind, generous, and incredibly caring. As a senior dog he spent a lot of time with them over the years and they always treated him like the good boy he was and were always happy to see him to the very end. He was happy and comfortable in their care and they were always honest and transparent with us concerning his care. Highly recommend them if you want compassionate staff who always make time for you, and make you and your pet feel safe and welcome. We are very grateful for the care they gave him.
Thank you for your wonderful feedback! We appreciate you taking the time to share your experience.
Excellent care and professionalism
Helen and the team are honest and take care of your pet like family!

Dr. Helen Foster saved my cat, literally. She heard a heart murmur, though very subtle, while I was visiting for a different concern. She suggested further exams which helped us find out about HCM and started blood thinners immediately. She continued following up with us and sending caring messages after we were referred to cardiology specialist. Now that my cat is living a healthy life, I realize I owe her a big thank you
Helpful and friendly staff :)
Excellent staff and doctors, definitely recommend

This veterinary office prioritizes revenue over the well-being of their patients. I have been a loyal client for nearly a decade, bringing two of my dogs here and spending tens of thousands of dollars over the years. Despite this long-standing relationship, today they refused to verify a prescription they themselves had issued for my dog’s medication because of an outstanding $30 fee— a charge they imposed simply for writing the prescription.

The issue stemmed from their failure to update the card I had provided on file during a prior visit. I also had another medication waiting to be picked up, which could have easily been settled at the same time. Instead, they chose to withhold service and treat a loyal client with disregard and a lack of appreciation.

My cat actually has passed away over a year ago now but animal care came up in conversation and it inspired me to write this review.  The care takers at this facility really did go above and beyond any expectation I could've had.  They provided excellent treatment and advice, were extremely compassionate and you could tell they cared about the animals they were helping. They even did a follow up call once where the little one was in a tough spot just to check in (things took a turn for the better in that particular circumstance) and I felt like that was a very kind thing to do. Thank you so much to you all 🥲
I love this vet so much. Everyone has been very kind and helpful. Would recommend if they're taking patients.
Vet team and front of house are always so lovely and caring. We know our dog is in great hands!
Very dedicated professionals, if you want everything well done with love and patience this is your place!
Everyone that works at Bickford genuinely cares about my senior dog Benny.  The care he gets here is top notch...  I can't say enough about how much I value everything about Bickford.  Thanks team.
The staff are amazing and have taken such good care of my dog over the years. They’re also organized and easy to get a hold of

I can't say enough good things about the care the folx have given my pup. Every single time we come in for something routine or for an urgent issue, they give us the full menu of options. Everything is explained with a pros and cons so we can make an informed decision about whether or not to do something.

I've never felt like we're being up-charged to do something unnecessary. We've had both Dr. Penkala and Dr. Brown see our dog, they've both been excellent. All of the technicians and front desk staff have been phenomenal.

We really feel like we're in good hands here and we're so fortunate to have them in our neighbourhood.
Couldn't recommend a more trustworthy vet.  Thanks Dr. Lisa and crew.

I went in to purchase hills prescription urgent care food for my dog. My vet said all vets should have the product and that I don’t need a prescription to get the food. When I asked the front receptionist for the product they responded with is my pet a patient here? Do I have a prescription for it? And why do I need it?  I have purchased the same product from here multiple times and they would gladly provide me with the product. I’ve noticed that with my prior dealings with this vet they are more concerned with taking my money and not the care of my beloved pets. I would not recommend using this vet there are so many other options in the area with a caring staff that would accommodate your needs.

Thank you for helping me navigate the sudden loss of my cat. Your staff are incredible - so kind and caring. Gretel's first visit to a veterinarian was yours, as a kitten, and it was sadly her last. I am so thankful for you folks, especially since I was a weeping disaster.

Kind, understanding, great people.

I have never had a long wait time to be seen, and they provide you with many options if your pet is deceased or at their end of life.

Highly recommended and very thankful.
Very patient and helpful. My dog loves all the staff!

Been coming to this vet for years. Always very friendly. And they don’t try to upsell you on anything. Very understanding of different price points and budgets, but also very caring about your animal.

Thank you so much to everyone at Bickford Park who has looked after Cat Larry.

This veterinary clinic shows a deep compassion to their animals and has seen …
Wonderful caring staff. Extremely knowledgeable doctors. Thank you!
The staff here are wonderful. We especially appreciated Dr. Ian’s expertise for helping diagnose and discuss treatment options for my senior dog.
This is a great hospital! Very, very accommodating and understanding for my anxious dog!
